clue.text: Maybe one who caulks a large vessel

definitions.meaning: to pitch a ship's seams is to seal them with tar, which is caulking work
a big jug for pouring water or milk

explanation.surface: A shipyard worker sealing the seams of a big ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who seals seams with pitch is one sense; the other is a large jug with a lip and handle.

clue.text: Hobby reminiscent of the previous generation?

definitions.meaning: a leisure activity
split as PAST TIME, a former era

explanation.surface: A hobby that harks back to one's parents' day.
explanation.definitionFit: A leisure pursuit; split in two it means a bygone era.

clue.text: What one expects to hear from a band of elephants

definitions.text: What one expects to hear from a band of elephants

parts.words: What one expects to hear from a band of elephants
parts.note: band reads as a musical group, but an elephant herd's call is the sound in question

explanation.surface: Wondering what music a herd of elephants would play.
explanation.walkthrough: Elephants make a loud call named after a brass instrument, which a musical band would also play.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a brass instrument heard in a band and the loud call an elephant makes.

clue.text: Heart-broken misanthropist

indicators.note: broken says the letters of heart are smashed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man whose heartbreak has turned him against humanity.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who detests people, as a misanthropist does.

clue.text: Took on another suit-with success for the plaintiff.

definitions.meaning: put clothes on again
a wrong that has been put right, as a court does for a claimant

explanation.surface: A lawsuit is refiled and the plaintiff wins.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's 'suit' is a lawsuit; in the first sense it is clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothed again is one sense; a grievance remedied or set right by a court is the other.

clue.text: Numbers displayed by entrants in bathing beauty contests

definitions.meaning: digits or numerals

definitions.text: displayed by entrants in bathing beauty contests
definitions.meaning: what contestants show off is their body shape

explanation.surface: Contestants at a beauty pageant parade with their entry numbers pinned on.
explanation.definitionFit: Numerals are one sense; the shapely physiques on show at a pageant are the other.

clue.text: Cigarette up to a lot of brands in America

definitions.text: a lot of brands in America

parts.note: fag is British slang for a cigarette

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says this little word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A smoke compared with many US cigarette brands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brands' are burning sticks, not trade names; a bundle of sticks is a faggot, spelt with one G in the US. FAG is British slang for a cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: A bundle of sticks for burning, US spelling; brands are pieces of burning wood.

clue.text: One who plays the game, is not bad, but doesn't win

parts.note: good is the opposite of bad
a loser is one who fails to win

explanation.surface: A sporting type who is decent but never comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plays the game' is the idiom for behaving fairly and sportingly; 'is' and 'but' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporting person who takes defeat graciously behaves fairly, playing by the rules.

clue.text: New hi-fi recording — free!

definitions.meaning: a newly issued record or album
to let go or set loose

explanation.surface: An advert offering a new stereo recording at no cost.
explanation.definitionFit: A newly issued record is one sense; to set loose is the other.

clue.text: Snake created by present disturbance

indicators.note: disturbance says the letters of present are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Unwrapping a gift and a snake appears.
explanation.definitionFit: A serpent is a snake, especially a large one.

clue.text: Pole tracked and side-tracked

parts.note: S is the south pole
pursued or followed, as prey is

explanation.surface: A Polish person followed and then diverted from their course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a nationality, but it is the S of south pole.
explanation.definitionFit: Shunting moves a train onto a siding, hence pushed aside or diverted.

clue.text: Dog carriage?

definitions.meaning: an animal that snarls a lot
an old four-wheeled horse-drawn cab

explanation.surface: A dog cart, or a carriage pulled by a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: A growler was the Victorian slang name for a four-wheeled hackney cab, from the rumble of its wheels.
explanation.definitionFit: A snarling dog is one sense; a Victorian four-wheeled hackney cab is the other.

clue.text: Tense expression of complete self-satisfaction

definitions.meaning: a verb form for past action still in progress
a smug boast, split as ...

explanation.surface: A nervous person boasting smugly about how flawless they are.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tense' looks like an adjective (nervous), but it is the grammar noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical verb form for unfinished past action; read as two words, it is a smug claim of flawlessness.

clue.text: Don't take a holiday

definitions.meaning: to let something stay where it is
time off work

explanation.surface: Advice to stay at work rather than go away on vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon or let something be is one sense; authorised time off from work is the other.

clue.text: Run in the next race

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the run of words the next race

explanation.surface: An athlete is entered to compete in the following heat.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an extra is a run scored without the batsman hitting the ball (a bye, wide or no-ball).
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bonus run not scored off the bat, such as a wide or bye, is called this.

clue.text: Astounded prospector is in luck by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says the phrase is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a lucky prospector has found ore, so ore struck

explanation.surface: A gold miner amazed at striking it lucky.
explanation.walkthrough: In British speech, without the R sound, 'ore struck' and the answer sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Filled with wonder, amazed.

clue.text: Getting on for ten scenes revised

indicators.note: revised says the letters of ten scenes are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A script editor reworking ten scenes of a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting on' means growing old; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageing, growing old.

clue.text: Australian navy raised food allowance, so the story goes

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised says the navy's letters are read upwards

parts.note: RAN is the Royal Australian Navy
a ration is an allowance of food

explanation.surface: Sailors down under got bigger rations, or so they say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns RAN into NAR in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The telling of a story, the account as it goes.

clue.text: Swindle inexperienced rival

parts.note: a con is a swindle
tender as in young and green, of tender years

explanation.surface: A con artist cheating a naive opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor for a title or prize is one's opponent.

clue.text: Small beds stuffed with heavy weight fabrics

indicators.note: stuffed with says the beds hold the weight inside them

parts.note: cots are small beds for infants
a ton is a heavy unit of weight

explanation.surface: Children's beds packed with thick, heavy cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloths woven from the fluffy fibre of the cotton plant.

clue.text: One who does not employ a legal term for neglect of what was right

definitions.meaning: someone who does not make use of something

definitions.text: a legal term for neglect of what was right
definitions.meaning: in law, failure to exercise a right, which may lose it

explanation.surface: A lawyer explaining a term for failing to use one's entitlement.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who abstains from use is one sense; in law, failure to exercise a right is the other.

clue.text: Walker returns to sum up

indicators.note: returns tells us the word for walker is read backwards

parts.note: a pacer is a horse or person that walks or sets a pace

explanation.surface: A hiker comes back and summarises the trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A short version of recapitulate: to restate the main points briefly.

clue.text: Study a hole in the rocks which is deeper in the centre

definitions.text: which is deeper in the centre

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
a cave is a hollow in rock

explanation.surface: Exploring a cave that gets deeper towards the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Curving inward, like the inside of a bowl, sunk in the middle.

clue.text: Excuse the introduction

definitions.meaning: a false reason given
read as ..., what comes before the main text

explanation.surface: Apologising for the preface of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A false reason offered is one sense; split up, it means words that come before the main body.

clue.text: Steadfast belief is unaffected by a setback

indicators.note: reading the word backwards leaves it unchanged, so a setback does it no harm

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone's firm conviction survives a reverse undamaged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setback' looks like misfortune, but it means the word read backwards: the five letters read the same either way.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle or doctrine firmly held.

clue.text: Mate rial measure put back into amendment issued by 17 across

indicators.note: into says the turned measure goes inside the word for amendment

parts.note: a change is an amendment

indicators.note: put back says the measure word is read backwards

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of cloth, a measure of material (printed as Mate rial)

explanation.surface: A contender's demand, with an alteration to the specifications of the cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mate rial' is the newspaper's split of 'Material'; an ell is an old cloth measure. 17 across is the rival, who throws down this call to compete.
explanation.definitionFit: A rival contender throws down a call to compete, a dare to fight.

clue.text: Shout with joy

definitions.meaning: a cry of encouragement or approval
gladness, as in good ...

explanation.surface: Someone shouting because they are happy.
explanation.definitionFit: A cry of applause is one sense; gladness and good spirits is the other.

clue.text: The word used by publishing houses to distinguish their books

definitions.meaning: in Greek philosophy and St John's Gospel, the divine Word

definitions.text: used by publishing houses to distinguish their books
definitions.meaning: emblems printed on book spines identifying the publisher

explanation.surface: Publishers stamping their brand mark on their books.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek term for the divine Word is one sense; the plural of the emblem a company uses is the other.

clue.text: Obsolete remedy results in cover up

parts.note: obs. is the dictionary abbreviation for obsolete
a cure is a remedy

explanation.surface: An outdated medical treatment leads to a hushing-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To hide or conceal something, to make it hard to see.

clue.text: On his head is where one should heap coals of fire

definitions.text: On his head is where one should heap coals of fire

parts.words: On his head is where one should heap coals of fire
parts.note: the Bible (Proverbs, Romans) says to repay ill with kindness, heaping coals of fire on an enemy's head; here the target is someone who repays kindness ungratefully

explanation.surface: Biblical advice about how to treat someone who has wronged you.
explanation.walkthrough: To heap coals of fire on someone's head is to shame them by returning good for evil.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person, who deserves to be shamed by kindness they have not repaid.

clue.text: One who is out to score a goal

definitions.text: One who is out to score a goal

parts.words: One who is out to score a goal
parts.note: a forward in football whose job is scoring; 'out' also hints at a worker who has walked out

explanation.surface: A footballer intent on finding the net.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' doubles as on strike: a worker who has downed tools is also this.
explanation.definitionFit: A football forward whose main job is scoring; also a worker who has downed tools.

clue.text: Just beginning the north-face climb

parts.note: a climb up a rock face is an ascent

explanation.surface: Mountaineers are just setting off up the north face.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming into being, emerging or starting to develop.
